nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE `confluent.log.source` = 'confluent-audit' AND (source = '{{audit_source}}' OR '{{audit_source}}' = 'all') TIMESERIES AUTO FACET type LIMIT 20

SELECT timestamp, type, `data.methodName`, `data.authenticationInfo.principal`, `data.authenticationInfo.identity`, `data.result.status`, `data.authorizationInfo.operation`, `data.authorizationInfo.resourceType`, `data.authorizationInfo.result`, source FROM Log WHERE `confluent.log.source` = 'confluent-audit' AND (source = '{{audit_source}}' OR '{{audit_source}}' = 'all') LIMIT 100

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE `confluent.log.source` = 'confluent-connector' AND (`data.context.connectorId` = '{{connector_id}}' OR '{{connector_id}}' = 'all') TIMESERIES AUTO FACET `data.context.connectorId` LIMIT 10

SELECT timestamp, `data.context.connectorId`, `data.summary.connectorErrorSummary.message`, `data.summary.connectorErrorSummary.rootCause`, source FROM Log WHERE `confluent.log.source` = 'confluent-connector' AND (`data.context.connectorId` = '{{connector_id}}' OR '{{connector_id}}' = 'all') LIMIT 100

nrqlQuery.query: SELECT uniques(source) FROM Log WHERE `confluent.log.source` = 'confluent-audit' SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT uniques(`data.context.connectorId`) FROM Log WHERE `confluent.log.source` = 'confluent-connector' SINCE 1 week ago
